parameters.name: DbName
parameters.description: The name of the DRDS database.

parameters.name: DrdsInstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of a DRDS instance.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The time when the SQL flashback task ends.

parameters.name: RecallRestoreType
parameters.description:
The restoration type. Valid values:

*   1: Image restoration
*   0: reverse recovery

parameters.name: RecallType
parameters.description:
Exact match or fuzzy match. Valid values:

*   0: the exact match.
*   1: the fuzzy match.

parameters.name: SqlPk
parameters.description: The primary key of flashback SQL.

parameters.name: SqlType
parameters.description: The type of the SQL statement. Valid values: INSERT, UPDATE, and DELETE. Separate multiple types with commas (,).

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The start time of the flashback SQL statement.

parameters.name: TableName
parameters.description: The name of the table where the flashback SQL operation was performed.

parameters.name: TraceId
parameters.description: The Trace ID of the flashback SQL.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun drds submit-sql-flashback-task --drds-instance-id drds000000000 --db-name test --start-time 2019-09-10_20:23:23 --end-time 2019-09-10_23:23:23 --trace-id ase00000 --table-name test --sql-type INSERT,UPDATE --sql-pk 11111 --recall-type 0 --recall-restore-type 0 --api-version 2019-01-23 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun drds SubmitSqlFlashbackTask --region cn-hangzhou --TableName test --RecallRestoreType 0 --DrdsInstanceId drds000000000 --EndTime '2019-09-10_23:23:23' --RecallType 0 --StartTime '2019-09-10_20:23:23' --TraceId ase00000 --DbName test --SqlType 'INSERT,UPDATE' --SqlPk 11111
